# Ruther Bergonia

> Ruther Bergonia is a software systems architect and senior full-stack engineer based in Metro Manila, Philippines. He designs, builds, deploys, and maintains production software for universities, institutional offices, government-related teams, SaaS companies, and operational organizations — replacing fragmented spreadsheets and manual workflows with secure platforms.

Primary title: Software Systems Architect & Senior Full-Stack Engineer

Core expertise: software systems architecture, full-stack development (Laravel, PHP, Vue.js, React, Next.js, TypeScript), API design and integration, MySQL and relational database design, authentication and authorization, role-based access control, workflow automation, institutional software, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, AI integration with controlled-response architectures (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, RAG), Docker, Linux server administration, Nginx, cloud deployment, and production support.

Selected verified work: SURI, a Laravel + Vue research information system at the University of the Philippines Manila managing 15,000+ records for 50+ users; GO-ARAL, a graduate application and ticketing portal supporting ~1,000 applicants annually at NGOHS, UP Manila; ARIA, a controlled-response AI support assistant; and RACE, an orchestration layer in development.

Contact: ruther.bergonia@gmail.com — available for remote projects across time zones; taking on a small number of new client projects for 2026.

## Quick answers

- **Who is Ruther Bergonia?** A software systems architect and senior full-stack engineer based in Metro Manila, Philippines, with 11+ years of experience. He currently leads architecture and development at the Research Grants Administration Office (RGAO), University of the Philippines Manila, and takes on independent client projects.
- **What does he build?** Production web platforms: research information systems, admissions and ticketing portals, role-based internal tools, multi-tenant SaaS, controlled-response AI assistants, and complete website + booking setups for local businesses.
- **What is his stack?** Laravel and PHP backends (also FastAPI); Vue.js, React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS frontends; MySQL; Docker, Linux, Nginx, and VPS/cloud deployment; Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini integration with retrieval-augmented generation.
- **Is he available for hire?** Yes — remote projects across time zones, and a small number of new client projects in 2026. Email ruther.bergonia@gmail.com; replies within one business day. Contact page: https://rmbergonia.com/contact/
- **How much does a small-business website cost?** The LocalBiz Digital Hub is ₱35,000 one-time for a website, online booking, Google Business profile, and messaging setup, live in 5–7 days. An optional ₱5,000/month care plan covers hosting, domain renewal, security updates, backups, and content changes; it is month to month. The client owns the domain and every login.
- **Where is he based?** Metro Manila, Philippines (GMT+8). LocalBiz Digital Hub is offered to businesses in Metro Manila; software work is remote.
- **Notable systems:** SURI (Laravel + Vue, 15,000+ research records, 50+ users, UP Manila), GO-ARAL (~1,000 graduate applicants a year, NGOHS UP Manila), ARIA (AI assistant that answers only from approved sources and hands off to humans), RACE (shared authentication/orchestration layer, in development).

- [GO-ARAL: graduate application & ticketing portal](https://rmbergonia.com/work/go-aral-graduate-support-platform/): ~1,000 applicants annually at NGOHS, UP Manila
- [ARIA: controlled-response AI support assistant](https://rmbergonia.com/work/aria-controlled-response-ai/): answers from approved sources, human handoff, tracked tickets
- [RACE: platform orchestration layer](https://rmbergonia.com/work/race-platform-orchestration/): shared authentication and services beneath SURI and ARIA (in development)

## Services

- [LocalBiz Digital Hub](https://rmbergonia.com/services/): ₱35,000 one-time website + online booking + Google Business profile + messaging setup for local businesses in Metro Manila, live in 5–7 days; optional ₱5,000/month care plan
- [LocalBiz templates](https://rmbergonia.com/services/templates/): six live demo sites, one per industry — dental clinic, salon & nails, café & restaurant, auto repair shop, gym & fitness studio, vet & pet grooming
